EmailTemplate.name: Case Management FASS CAP 3rd missed call attempt
EmailTemplate.subject: RE: {!Case.Subject}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Contact.FirstName},
We’ve been trying to reach you via this email and at [PHONE] to let you know that your financial aid file is incomplete. Unfortunately, this is preventing you from participating in the Starbucks College Achievement Plan. Please contact us immediately if we can help resolve this issue.
We’ll stop calling in case we have a wrong number or you prefer not to talk, but if at any time you have questions or concerns about financial aid or the Starbucks College Achievement Plan, we would like to help. You can reach Financial Aid and Scholarship Services by replying to this email, calling 1-844-ASU-6693, or using the Service Center on MyASU.
Sincerely, {!User.FirstName} {!User.LastName}
Financial Aid and Scholarship Services Arizona State University PO Box 870412 Tempe, AZ 85287-0412 Phone: 1-844-278-6693
If you have any additional information or questions related to this, please reply to this email.
